title: Backend Blockchain Integration

p62_audit.device_ai_suite_note: 1 pre-existing unrelated failure (test_detector_benchmark.py timing artifact), unchanged from P6.2
p62_audit.conclusion: P6.2's blockchain integration remains fully working and untouched; nothing to fix

architectural_finding.gap: backend/'s Submission model (prisma/schema.prisma) has no deviceId/passportFingerprint/ecoId field; zero relationship to intelligence/device_ai's DeviceRecord/DevicePassport
architectural_finding.verification: grep for passportFingerprint/DevicePassport/device_ai/8100 across backend/src returned zero matches before this phase
architectural_finding.fabric_ai_clients_confirmed_placeholders: backend/src/infrastructure/fabric/fabric.client.ts and infrastructure/ai/ai.client.ts explicitly marked Phase 7/Phase 8, zero import sites
architectural_finding.decision: device-level integration requires a real schema/product decision (e.g. adding devicePassportFingerprint to Submission) out of this phase's scope per Phase 13 constraints and CLAUDE.md's schema-change rules; not attempted unilaterally

what_was_built.description: Real, working, read-only blockchain health proxy from backend/ to the Python intelligence/device_ai service's P6.2 Fabric Gateway health check
what_was_built.degradation_behavior: network failure/timeout/non-OK/malformed payload all resolve to status: proxy_unreachable with HTTP 200, never a fabricated 'connected' status, never a 5xx for an unreachable upstream
what_was_built.http_client: Node 18+ built-in global fetch, no new dependency added
what_was_built.write_side_status: submitTransaction/evaluateTransaction remain the Phase-7 placeholder — only the health/query side was connected, honestly

test_metrics.backend_lint_note: 12 real @typescript-eslint findings fixed in new test files (require-await, unnecessary type assertion)

limitations: No device-level blockchain integration (anchor/verify a specific submission's passport) — blocked on a real schema/product decision
Health proxy adds one extra network hop (mobile -> backend -> device_ai)
No caching of the health result — every call makes a fresh upstream request
